name: E-cast
prompt: PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE SHEET, THUONG TU T1 MALE, E EXACT RIGHT PROFILE in EVERY FRAME. First input256-square is the locked master: use same adult face/slate almond eye/straight brow/angular jaw, swept black main hair and LOW ponytail, navy plain sleeveless wrap with ivory undercollar, red sash tails, compact dark trousers, wrist wraps and small dark boots; no armor/gems/embroidery. Same dark straight spear, simple steel leaf tip and forked RED pennon. Second input is authoritative4x4 LATTICE plus EXACT MASTER HEAD STENCILS for scale/identity and ground/foot guides. Draw a square2048x2048 sheet with4columns x4rows, each cell512square, exactly16 row-major cells; preserve every cell registration; no overlap between cells. Logical cell256: standing main crown y16, soles y232, head skull+hair about50px tall matching stencil; enlarged2x in512cell so crown32/soles464/head100. Scale fixed; body main-crown-to-sole216logicalpx, NEVER fit individual frame heights. Stencil is size/face guide, head may translate/rotate with pose but must not shrink/grow. Art 2cel tones+one highlight, material-tinted clean outline, NW light. Solid perfectly flat magenta #FF00FF everywhere outside artwork. REMOVE ALL guide lines/foot ghosts/markers, no text/numbers/borders/ground shadows/halos. Entire spear/banner/low ponytail/hands/feet stay inside each cell with safe margin; do not clip at grid edges, do not shrink body to fit spear. First frame must closely match master scale/identity. No perspective zoom, no front face/three-quarter. Small hands/feet, adult compact4.5-head anatomy. CAST one-shot16 unique sequential drawings. Same E profile male spear cultivator, feet brace apart, one hand retains vertical/slightly angled spear while free hand draws a focused casting gesture. Frames0-4 gather/anticipation,5-8 raise free palm and lean into cast,9-10 release forward right,11-15 settle/recover. Preserve spear/redpennon in every cell; tip stays under top margin (angle spear tofit, do not shorten/shrink). Head same physical skull size, eyes/face fixed, small hands legible and sleeve-free. No big magical VFX painted over body/hand/weapon; only tiny restrained wind-white accent at release if needed, proposed element is not locked. Hair/pennon/sash have clear delayed motion and settle. No camera rotation/zoom; full body and weapon inside cell.16 populated, no labels/guide marks/shadows.
